sections.heading: No-options Objective Questions
sections.content: These questions target conceptual fluency and procedural mastery. Work through each systematically:
instructions: Verify base conversions by reverse conversion.

sections.heading: STRUCTURED THEORY: QUESTIONS
sections.content: These demand rigorous reasoning and proof:
instructions: Distinguish between counterexamples (disproving universal claims) and proofs (establishing general truths).
Link algebraic manipulations back to conceptual understanding (e.g., why nibble grouping works).

preparation_strategy.title: Preparation Strategy for Elite Performance
steps: Master Section A first: Ensure automatic recall of conversion methods, set properties, and dimensional analysis.
Study Section B answers deeply: Understand not just the final answer, but why each step is necessary.
Practice explaining: Write out solutions as if teaching someone; gaps in understanding surface immediately.
Test Students: Attempt these under timed conditions mimicking real exams.
